subject.title: fix(whatsapp): preserve active connections across runtime reloads

question: Should this runtime lifecycle repair land before the stacked QA-only PR at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110754, after a current-main rebase and focused reload proof?
rationale: The PR changes the ownership lifetime of the registry that routes active WhatsApp controllers for outbound delivery, and the related QA branch is based on this branch; that landing order is a maintainer release-risk decision rather than a mechanical contributor fix.

options.title: Land runtime repair first
options.body: Rebase this PR on current `main`, rerun the reload and outbound-controller proof, then land it before rebasing the QA-only follow-up.

options.title: Hold both for combined review
options.body: Pause this PR and the dependent QA PR until maintainers want to review the runtime lifecycle and the scenario-harness repairs as one sequence.

recommendation.title: Land runtime repair first
recommendation.body: Rebase this PR on current `main`, rerun the reload and outbound-controller proof, then land it before rebasing the QA-only follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared runtime-context integration and authored both the production repair and its related QA follow-up.
